Title: Public Preview: Azure SQL updates for late-August 2025

Body.Content:
In late August 2025, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL: 

  • Azure SQL Database now offers a replication lag metric, providing real-time visibility into the recovery point objective (RPO) when Geo-DR is enabled. Learn more.
